# Elementor Ultra — exjsx.dev

> The agent-native build stack for Elementor. AI agents write typed JSX; a compiler
> ships native, editable Elementor V4 pages over REST; verification gates check every
> save at 1200/1920/390. Open source, MIT. This page itself was built by an AI agent
> with this stack.

## Setup (paste to any MCP-capable agent)
Set up Elementor Ultra on this machine by fetching and following
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Algorismus-io/elementor-ultra/main/SETUP.md
exactly, step by step. Work autonomously and verify each step.

## Wizard
npx @algorismus/create-elementor-ultra

## Stack
- https://github.com/Algorismus-io/elementor-jsx — compiler + CLI (@algorismus/elementor-jsx)
- https://github.com/Algorismus-io/elementor-ultra-mcp — MCP server, ~90 tools + companion WP plugin
- https://github.com/Algorismus-io/elementor-ultra-studio — verification gates + measure toolkit
- https://github.com/Algorismus-io/elementor-ultra-playground — local WordPress, no Docker

## Docs
- https://docs.wpos.ai/ultra
- https://docs.wpos.ai/ultra/examples/overview — 8 sites built live on camera, one prompt each

## Note
On this page, press A (or use the switch) for the machine surface.
